text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Today is the first race of the Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho. But I feel strange… Is it really my destiny to run in this race?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh well, whatever. This race will tell me whether I should focus on miles or take on the 2,400-meter Japanese Oaks!
